{{Top|leg}}
'''Reconciliation efforts''' were made by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the defeat of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Among efforts made was the release of certain [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] from [[Prison/Legends|prison]], such as the former [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] star and CIS defector [[Kob Mondray]].
